facts.text: The user requested a tagline for a Cloud Economics marketing campaign.
The user wanted the tagline to encapsulate saving dollars during uncertain economic times.
The user wanted the tagline to emphasize reducing cloud computing expense.
The user wanted the tagline to highlight freeing up valuable resources.
The user wanted the tagline to mention improving the balance sheet or redirecting resources to areas of critical need.
The user wanted the tagline to reflect increased emphasis on cost controls across almost all categories.
The user wanted the tagline to reference returning economic value to shareholders and investors.
The user wanted the tagline to include examples of economic value actions such as widespread layoffs.
The user wanted the tagline to include examples of economic value actions such as reduction in major capital projects.
The user wanted the tagline to include examples of economic value actions such as reluctance to sign big SOWs.
The user wanted the tagline to convey that companies are more reluctant to commit spend during economic uncertainty.
The user wanted the tagline to state that the need for controlling costs is at an all-time high.
The user asked for something more concise and energetic.

keyphrases: need for controlling costs at an all-time high
